_comment: Core tests that may skip in a Linux lane before merge, by exact node id. Read by scripts/suews/check_core_guard.py; an entry that no longer skips, or names a test that is not a core test of its lane, fails the guard. Adding an entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

allowed.reason: Needs the standalone SPARTACUS executable built with NetCDF and OpenMP (src/suews/ext_lib/spartacus-surface/bin/spartacus_surface), which no CI wheel lane builds; the fixture skips without it.
